source.quantityConvention: Observer-centered IAU76/80 ecliptic-of-date apparent longitude and latitude, including light-time, solar gravitational deflection, and stellar aberration; airless/geocentric.
source.timeConvention: Horizons output time is UT; for this post-1962 date the output is UTC. LIFE supplies UTC-derived Julian Day as a UT1 approximation without DUT1 correction.

comparison.engineMode: Swiss Ephemeris, geocentric apparent tropical ecliptic longitude/latitude, default flags plus speed; local bundled ephemeris assets; UTC treated as UT1 approximation
comparison.toleranceRationale: Allows for printed reference rounding, small time-scale/model/frame realization differences, while remaining tighter than typical chart-display precision.
comparison.independenceNote: This is an independent JPL Horizons/DE441 computation snapshot compared with the Swiss binding and bundled Swiss data. It is one epoch, so it does not establish broad historical accuracy, time-scale correctness, or independence of the upstream planetary observations used by the ephemeris products.
